bugs.fix: Did NOT fix the engine in this session — applied the hypetheme DI fix surgically with Edit instead. Filed bead 682r to add format-preserving printer support to AbstractRule and migrate every rule's apply() to use it. Until then: do not invoke LowercasePluginIdCallsites / ExceptionClassRenames / RemovedFunctions / DiObjectToCreate via the engine on real plugins; apply manually.

Too few arguments to function hypeJunction\Scraper\AddBookmarkRiverPreview::__invoke(), 1 passed and exactly 4 expected
bugs.root_cause: Elgg 4.x passes a single \Elgg\Hook object to hook handlers; migrate/elgg-4.x branch had 3 handlers (AddBookmarkRiverPreview, AddBookmarkProfilePreview, FilteroEmbedHtml) still using the 3.x 4-argument signature ($hook, $type, $return, $params)
bugs.fix: Changed all 3 handlers to use Hook $hook signature, accessed $hook->getValue() for return value, replaced elgg_instanceof() with instanceof, lowercased plugin id callsites

bugs.error_message: array_keys(): Argument #1 ($array) must be of type array, Elgg\Menu\PreparedMenu given
bugs.root_cause: Elgg 4.x passes a PreparedMenu object (iterable, not array) to menu views. menus_api's navigation/menu/default.php called array_keys($menu) expecting a plain array
bugs.fix: Rewrote view to check for PreparedMenu instanceof, iterate with foreach($menu as $section) where $section is MenuSection, use $section->getID() and $section->all()

bugs.root_cause: elgg_get_loaded_js() was removed in Elgg 4.x. bodyology_theme foot.php used it for both 'head' and 'footer' JS loading
bugs.fix: Replaced elgg_get_loaded_js('footer') with elgg_get_loaded_external_resources('js', 'footer') and used $resource->url. Removed the 'head' JS loop (now handled by Elgg core in head.php)

Fatal error: Trait "Elgg\Di\ServiceFacade" not found in InteractionsService.php
bugs.root_cause: Elgg 6.x removed Elgg\Di\ServiceFacade trait; InteractionsService used it. Also injected PluginHooksService (removed in 6.x) via constructor. Fatal during bootCore because class is autoloaded by DI container.
bugs.fix: Removed ServiceFacade trait usage, added manual instance() method, changed constructor to no-arg, replaced $this->hooks->trigger() with elgg_trigger_event_results().

bugs.error_message: Call to undefined function elgg_register_plugin_hook_handler() + Elgg\Hook class not found in handler classes
bugs.root_cause: Elgg 6.x removed entire plugin hook API: elgg_register_plugin_hook_handler, Elgg\Hook class, elgg_trigger_plugin_hook. Bootstrap.php and 9 handler classes still used these.
bugs.fix: Bootstrap: replaced all elgg_register_plugin_hook_handler/unregister with elgg_register/unregister_event_handler. Handlers: Hook $hook → \Elgg\Event $event, elgg_trigger_plugin_hook → elgg_trigger_event_results, renamed $event local vars to $notification_event where collision. Router static methods converted from old-style (hook,type,url,params) to (\Elgg\Event $event).
